schema.province_history.title: Province histories
schema.province_history.name: Province history
schema.province_history.doc: Histories in history/provinces/<folder>/<id> - <Name>.txt: one file per province, whose id is the number its name starts with. Values change with the date: what is outside the dated blocks holds from the start, and each «date = …» block changes it from that day on.
schema.province_history.field.add_core.h: Countries that claim it as their own. Added with add_core and removed with remove_core.
schema.province_history.field.terrain.he: Replaces the terrain that comes from terrain.bmp. Almost no province uses it.
